newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev firms vs dollar, follows mark gains.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev firms vs dollar, follows mark gains.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev rose to 1,815-1,818 per dollar at the opening from 1,820-1,823 at Wednesday's close in line with mark/dollar gains on global markets, dealers said.

* The lev opened flat on Wednesday's close of 994.50-995.50 against the mark, close to the central bank currency board bid of 995, amid seasonally low interest for foreign currency buying from large end customers.
* Lev/mark trade was expected to be quiet near the 995 level. Local traders adjust the lev/dollar to the domestic lev/mark and global mark/dollar.

* Under a fixed exchange rate mechanism, called a currency board and intoduced on July 1, Bulgaria's central bank pledged to buy and sell unlimited volumes of marks, the anchor currency, at a bid of 995 levs and ask of 1,000. -- Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 91188
